d: Gurugram’s rural belt is witnessing a sporting transformation. Across villages such as Baliawas and Badshahpur, farmlands are giving way to floodlit box cricket arenas, drawing corporate employees, groups of friends and sports enthusiasts looking for a game after work. With rising bookings and landowners finding a new income source, box cricket is emerging as a lucrative business in rural Gurugram. From investments in artificial turfs to soaring land prices, discover how villages on the outskirts of the Millennium City are turning fields into sporting destinations.
